name: Wave

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Debilitate: Debilitate dışında yeni uygulanan debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Heavy Proficiency: Ağır saldırılar sırasında saldırı gücünü belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Untouchable: Gelen saldırıların belirtilen olasılıkla ıskalama (Miss) şansı vardır.
abilityDetails.Battered: Alınan vuruşlar, o anki saldırı gücüne dayalı ek fiziksel hasar patlaması verdirir.

signatureAbility:
Hydrotherapy
When a non-Instant Poison or Incinerate on Wave expires, gain a Regeneration Passive healing [30 - 70]% of the damage taken from those effects over 4 seconds. Against Mystic Opponents, this includes Degeneration.
Wave's Debilitate, Tracking, and Battered Debuffs become Severe against Mystic Opponents.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir süresini %75 azaltır 🧪⏰
• Yakma süresini %75 azaltır 🔥⏰

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Utilizing her power over water, Wave can dilute Poisons and snuff out Incinerates, reducing their duration by 75%. Additionally, her Regeneration Rate cannot be reduced by Poison.
Wave's personal Debuffs are all paused if either Champion hasn't landed a hit for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Furystyle
content: When Wave Intercepts or causes an attack to Miss, she gains a +[1,124.4]] Fury Passive for 5 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
When Wave avoids a hit with the Dexterity Mastery, she gains one of these Furies instead of a Precision Buff.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Medley
content: Wave can charge a Heavy Attack after a non-Combo-Ending Attack to Passively Stun the Opponent for 0.75 seconds.
The 4th hit of a Basic Attack combo, including Heavy Attacks, inflicts a 25% Debilitate Debuff for 8 seconds. Wave's Debilitate doesn't affect stun Debuffs. Max stacks: 4.
The first hit of a Heavy Attack inflicts a [305.56] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 8 seconds. Max stacks: 4.
Punishing a Special Attack grants a non-stacking +[33,732] Heavy Proficiency Passive until the final hit of Wave's Heavy Attack. While active, her Heavies can not Critically Hit.

abilitySections.title: Untouchable Wave
content: Heavy Attacks ready an Untouchable Wave.

Untouchable Wave allows Wave to Dash towards the Opponent during their Special Attacks in a rushing wave of water becoming Passively Untouchable until shortly after she starts an attack. If this causes an attack to Miss, unready Untouchable Wave.
Untouchable Wave inflicts a Tracking Debuff for 4 seconds. This is also inflicted at the start of each fight.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Eskrimador
content: Each hit inflicts one of Wave's Debilitates and Physical Vulnerabilities.
During this attack, Wave gains a +[1,124.4] Fury Passive for each Debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Overpowering Wave
content: On hit, inflict a non-stacking [4,497.6] Battered Debuff for 3.5 seconds if one is not active. It is paused during Specials and Strikers, and remains paused until Wave or her Opponent land a hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Queen of the Seven Seas
content: Gain a stack of Paruparo. Max: 2.
Each stack of Paruparo increases the max stacks of Wave's Physical Vulnerabilities and Debilitates by 2, and increases the potency of her Battered by 25%.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Hydrotherapy
content: When a non-Instant Poison or Incinerate on Wave expires, gain a Regeneration Passive healing [30 - 70]% of the damage taken from those effects over 4 seconds. Against Mystic Opponents, this includes Degeneration.
Wave's Debilitate, Tracking, and Battered Debuffs become Severe against Mystic Opponents.
